I.value_zh: Bridgeflow 现场涌现叙述、四类 incident/涌现、既有 essays、TASK/ADR/protocol 引用和 ADMIN 问题。
I.value_en: Bridgeflow emergence narrative, incident/emergence categories, existing essays, TASK/ADR/protocol references, and ADMIN question.
I.notes_zh: 不访问 Bridgeflow 或引用文档以验证数据。
I.notes_en: Bridgeflow and referenced documents are not accessed for data verification.

O.value_zh: 四篇指定 essays、每篇独立 REPORT、一份汇总 REPORT、索引条目和相互链接。
O.value_en: Four specified essays, a separate REPORT per essay, one summary REPORT, index entries, and mutual links.
O.notes_en: Does not mean essays are written.

A.value_zh: 按 D1、D4、D3、D2 顺序撰写并落盘四篇中文为主的 essays，逐篇提交 REPORT，最后汇总 REPORT 并归档；任务是否仍可启动由状态和宿主裁决，不能从动作槽推断。
A.value_en: Write and persist four primarily Chinese essays in D1, D4, D3, D2 order, submit a REPORT for each, then submit a summary REPORT and archive; whether the task may still start depends on status and Host decision, not the action slot.
A.notes_zh: 动作内容明确不等于当前执行获准；本审定不写作或发布。
A.notes_en: Clear action content does not mean current execution is authorized; this review performs no writing or publication.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 为发件人与审阅/接受方，ME 为拟议写作和逐篇报告提交方；底部接受记录与 frontmatter 取消状态的时序未说明，不据此推导当前授权。
P.value_en: ADMIN is sender and intended reviewer/acceptor; ME is the proposed writer and per-essay REPORT submitter. The timing between footer acceptance and front-matter cancellation is unspecified and does not establish current authority.
P.notes_zh: 岗位标签和历史接受语句不能替代 OperatorProfile 或当前状态核验。
P.notes_en: Role labels and historical acceptance text do not replace an OperatorProfile or current-state check.

R.value_zh: 四篇总计约 15–20k 中文字；A 约 6–8k、D 约 4–5k、C 约 3–4k、B 起步约 2–3k；D1 要求“今晚先交”，但未给出具体截止时刻。
R.value_en: Approximately 15–20k Chinese characters overall; A about 6–8k, D about 4–5k, C about 3–4k, and B initially about 2–3k; D1 is to be delivered tonight, but no precise cutoff time is given.
R.notes_zh: P1/low 是优先级/风险；五份 REPORT 与写作顺序属交付与依赖，不是资源配额。
R.notes_en: P1/low denotes priority/risk; five REPORTs and writing order belong to outputs and dependencies, not resource budgets.

V.value_zh: FCoP 既有 essays、TASK-001..004、TASK-003、fcop-protocol.mdc、ADR/protocol 引用和 Bridgeflow 现场来源。
V.value_en: Existing FCoP essays, TASK-001..004, TASK-003, fcop-protocol.mdc, ADR/protocol references, and Bridgeflow source.
V.notes_zh: 引用数据必须真，无法核实需标未核实。
V.notes_en: Referenced data must be true and marked unverified if unverifiable.

C.value_zh: 四篇落盘、frontmatter、相关链接、交叉引用、五份 REPORT、索引四条目和不 bump 版本。
C.value_en: Four persisted essays, front matter, related links, cross-references, five REPORTs, four index entries, and no version bump.

B.value_zh: 不得写代码细节、编造现场数据、将 incident 美化为表扬、堆 emoji/亲爱的读者、bump 版本；仅叙事文档。
B.value_en: Do not write code detail, fabricate incident data, praise incidents, pile emoji/dear-reader tone, or bump versions; narrative documents only.
B.notes_zh: 未核实数据需显式标注。
